messages:
Ada: Quick thread — thinking about a per-route 'Queryflow' inspector in Console analytics. Needs to show per-model breakdown, applied routing policy, and a compact saved-query bar. Thoughts?
Yasmin: +1. Key is clarity of scope — saved queries should default to route but allow project/org scope. UX: small chip that says 'scope: route' and a dropdown.
Mike: Technical: we also need to surface active routing policy (e.g., primary model + fallback list) and quota windows. Can we reuse /routes/:id/telemetry endpoint to fetch this?
Rohan: From infra: endpoint returns telemetry but not policy bindings. We have /routing/policies/{route_id} API but it's heavier. Could cache in Console.
Yasmin: UI mock: show a model-pivot column with sparkline, avg latency, error%, cost/token. Then filters: time, model, env (prod/stage), policy-version. Tiny mock:
```
filters = {time: '1h', model: 'gpt-4o', env: 'prod', policy: 'v12'}
```
Ada: Saved-queries question: default save should be 'route' and checkbox 'share with team'. Product wants discoverability.
Mike: Implementation concern: saved query key needs to include policy-version to avoid stale results when policy changes. Also need migration when route renamed.
Rohan: Also watch quota interplay: console should surface remaining quota per-route for both tokens and concurrency. We can add an infra endpoint that joins billing/quotas.
Yasmin: UX: inline warning if a saved query references a model not available in current deployment -> show a pill 'model unavailable' with quick fallback suggestions.
Ada: Would be great to have a 'replay' button to re-run query as a curated check for rollouts (A/B). That ties into rollouts UX.
Mike: For rollouts, we should show policy split (50% modelA, 50% modelB) and allow 'drill into variant' metric breakdowns.
Rohan: Security: saved queries with org scope need RBAC; default route-scope editable by route owners only.
Ada: Action items: Yasmin to mock 2 variants (compact list vs inspector panel). Mike to outline API needs: telemetry + policy join + quota. Rohan to prototype quota join. I'll schedule sync Wed.
Yasmin: I'll attach quick Figma link later. :sparkles:
deploy-bot: Deployed telemetry v1 to staging at 1768504600
Mike: Nice, I'll start wiring UI to staging endpoints.
Ada: Thanks all — keeping this thread to track decisions.
